title: service_order.delivered payload
description: Published by M01 when a repaired or serviced item is handed to the customer and the handover evidence is recorded. This is the BILLABLE EVENT M20 consumes (M01 §12.2). It carries what was done; it never carries an instruction to raise an invoice (IN-003 SC-05, AR-009 P-01).

x-registration.comment_on_replay_class: R1 because every consumer of this event is an idempotent projection or a guarded creation. M20's invoice creation is R2 and carries its own already-done check; it is the CONSUMER that declares its class, not the event.
x-registration.comment_on_retention: operational_30d, NOT financial_7y. The event is the trigger; the INVOICE it causes is the financial record and carries the 7-year obligation. Classifying the trigger as financial would place 30 days of routine operational traffic under a statutory hold.

service_order_id.description: The aggregate identifier. Also the partition key component (AR-009 §4.2).

delivered_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. WHEN THE HANDOVER HAPPENED, not when the event was published (AR-009 occurred_at semantics). For an offline capture this is the field-captured time, which the client wins on under AR-010's authority matrix.

delivery_mode.description: Open enumeration under SC-11: a value may be added within this schema_version, so every consumer must carry a default branch.

customer.description: Identifier and type only. NEVER a nested customer representation (SC-10) — an event that embeds half the database becomes a snapshot with a stale fuse.

handover.description: Custody transfer evidence. Retained for the legal evidence period by the DOCUMENT retention rule, not by this event's retention class.

received_by_name.description: Length is in CHARACTERS, not bytes — a 200-character Bengali name is ~600 bytes in UTF-8 (IN-002 BN-02).

signature_attachment_id.description: Claim check (AR-009 P-05). A reference to object storage — the signature image never travels on the bus, in the DLQ, or into a consumer's inbox.

billable_summary.description: SC-06: enough for M20 to raise an invoice WITHOUT calling back. An event that forces every consumer to fetch the record has moved the coupling, not removed it (AR-009 P-02).

code.description: From MD-020 (services) or the parts master.

warranty_covered.description: Drives whether M09 raises a claim and whether M20 bills the customer or the brand.

currency_note.description: Present only where the order was priced in a currency other than BDT (M65).

entitlement.description: Present where a contract or warranty covered part or all of the work.

rework_of.description: Set when this order is rework of a previous one — the linkage M23 and M57 need for attribution.

Money.description: AS-10 / AR-009 P-06 / IN-003 SC-02. STRING decimal, never a float — a float cannot represent BDT 0.10 exactly and a bank reconciliation will eventually disagree by paisa.

Reference.description: SC-10. A cross-aggregate reference carries an identifier and a type, never a nested representation.
